metadata.title: A Metadata Pipeline for a Research Library
metadata.summary: The paper proposes a data engineering workflow to manage research papers accumulating in shared folders by converting PDFs to Markdown and extracting structured metadata using a local language model. This process stores the extracted metadata in an SQLite database, which is then supported by a static HTML catalogue for searching. The main contribution is the integration of file discovery, document conversion, metadata validation, and incremental cataloging to reduce manual cataloguing work.
